factions.name: Tank
factions.description: Durable frontline heroes with high HP who soak damage and use crowd control to initiate or disrupt fights.

factions.name: Warrior
factions.description: Hybrid bruisers blending moderate survivability with strong sustained damage, common in the solo lane or jungle.

factions.name: Assassin
factions.description: High-mobility burst-damage heroes who dive past the frontline to eliminate fragile marksmen and mages quickly.

factions.name: Mage
factions.description: Ranged spellcasters dealing high burst magic damage and area control from a distance.

factions.name: Marksman
factions.description: Ranged basic-attack carries who deal sustained physical damage while staying positioned away from danger.

factions.name: Support
factions.description: Utility heroes providing healing, shields, buffs and crowd control to protect and empower their team.

cards.name: Arthur
cards.description: Sword-and-shield tank who gains bonus armor as he levels, leaps onto marked targets, and finishes fights with the true-damage Deep Impact.

cards.name: Grakk
cards.description: Jungle initiator best known for the Devil's Chain hook that drags enemies out of position, followed by heavy lockdown from his ultimate World Devourer.

cards.name: Thane
cards.description: Unstoppable charger who suppresses and knocks up enemies before slamming the ground and finishing with the heavy true-damage ultimate King's Glory.

cards.name: Ormarr
cards.description: Bruiser-style tank who stacks stun chances on every hit and sustains through fights with the HP-restoring ultimate Walking Tall.

cards.name: Yena
cards.description: Dual-wielding warrior/assassin who switches between fast Light Blade mobility and slower, harder-hitting Heavy Blade form, stacking Mark of the Blade to silence and slow foes.

cards.name: Veres
cards.description: High-damage solo-lane warrior who commands a serpent companion for slows, stuns and sustain, gaining crowd-control immunity while empowered.

cards.name: Wukong
cards.description: Trickster warrior/assassin, the Monkey King, who baits enemies with a decoy clone before charging in and knocking foes airborne with his staff.

cards.name: Airi
cards.description: Dagger-wielding assassin/warrior who lands true-damage strikes every fourth hit, dashes through walls with Shadow, and locks down foes with her spirit-summoning ultimate Ryuu.

cards.name: Nakroth
cards.description: Highly mobile blade assassin/warrior who leaps and dashes to reposition before unleashing a crowd-control-immune flurry of strikes with Judgment's Blade.

cards.name: Butterfly
cards.description: Kill-chaining assassin whose passive resets her ability cooldowns and heals her on kills or assists, letting her snowball through repeated team fights.

cards.name: Krixi
cards.description: Long-range poke mage who harasses with her boomeranging Mischief butterfly and bombards team fights with meteors from her ultimate, Moonfall.

cards.name: Liliana
cards.description: Shapeshifting mage/assassin who pokes from range in human form, then transforms into her Fox Form for close-range burst damage and crowd control.

cards.name: Zata
cards.description: Long-range mage/assassin whose overlapping projectile skills detonate for extra burst damage, with an ultimate that lets him soar above the battlefield.

cards.name: Violet
cards.description: Long-range marksman known for explosive poke damage and mobility, sniping enemies from outside their own attack range before finishing with Kinetic Rounds.

cards.name: Valhein
cards.description: Magic-damage marksman who blends control and burst, using frequent stuns and speed boosts to run down opponents before unloading his ultimate, Bullet Storm.

cards.name: Capheny
cards.description: Mobile marksman who can fire while moving, switching between Rapid Shot and Pulse Shot modes and shredding enemy armor with her ultimate, Fusillade.

cards.name: Alice
cards.description: Crowd-control support who stuns and heals with Sunshine, shields and speeds up allies with Friendship, and slows and weakens enemies with her ultimate, Hissy Fit.
